text:
mira: Quick note - the ruby quickstart stream sample is dropping with 401s right after we rotate short-lived tokens in the dashboard. repro below.

mira: Minimal repro: clone sampleapp-rb, start stream with RB_TOKEN=ephemeral, then click rotate token in admin. After rotation the stream connection errors out.

mira: Console output: 
```
[stream] connected
[auth] token rotated
[stream] recv: 401 Unauthorized - token invalid
```

alex: does the sync/gRPC path do refresh correctly?

mira: sync requests pick up new token fine. Only streaming path is problematic.

sam: sounds like the client captures auth headers at connect and never refreshes them for reconnect. go client has a Transport that calls TokenProvider() on each dial; rb uses cached header in StreamClient#connect.

toni: can someone paste the connect code?

mira: snippet: 
```
# sampleapp/rb stream client
def connect
  socket = TCPSocket.new(host, port)
  socket.write("GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1\r\nAuthorization: Bearer #{@initial_token}\r\n\r\n")
  @socket = socket
end
```

sam: exact problem. quick patch: call token_provider.token instead of @initial_token when building headers, so reconnect picks up rotated token. add backoff 100-500ms jitter, cap 5 tries.

toni: i'll open a tiny PR to change connect to read current token and add a test to simulate provider swapping mid-stream. will mimic existing retry window (exponential).

toni: proposed change (pseudo): 
```
- Authorization: Bearer #{@initial_token}
+ Authorization: Bearer #{token_provider.current}
```

ci-bot: PR #601 opened by toni: fix/rb-stream-reconnect-use-current-token (checks: lint, unit, integration).

ci-bot: integration: stream-reconnect-test timed out (flaky infra).

jen: fyi we've seen that timeout intermittently on macos runners; might need to mock socket rather than rely on live net.

toni: good call. updated test to inject fake socket and control timing. re-run.

ci-bot: integration passed. unit tests passed. lint passed.

alex: great. can we add a tiny note in quickstart README about ephemeral tokens and streaming caveats? also add CHANGELOG entry.

sam: i'll run cross-language smoke vs go client to ensure parity; will add e2e test that rotates provider during streaming.

mira: verified locally - stream no longer 401s after rotation. thanks! :tada:

toni: i'll cherry-pick to maintenance branch `v0.7.x` and bump sampleapp version. opening release PR after that.

mira: tagging @qa-team to add regression case to their harness.

alex: wrap-up: docs + changelog + qa regression + release PR. ack?

mira: ack. closing once QA confirms. :thumbsup:
